preconditions.description: The length of string s must be between 1 and 1000.
The integer k must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of string s must be divisible by k.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if all(s[i:i+len(s)//k] == s[i:i+len(s)//k][::-1] for i in range(0, len(s), len(s)//k)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if s can be split into k palindromes of the same length, otherwise output 'NO'.
